messages:
Nia (PM): quick thread 1: packaging decision needed for 'usage lanes' and priority credits. customers want predictable SLAs for bursty workloads.
Omar (Sales): field feedback: ISVs want a simple add-on you can quote on a PO: "priority lane block of N hours" not a per-token line. procurement prefers fixed-line items.
Jules (Eng): infra reality: priority lane == reserved capacity + faster scheduling. we can implement as time-block reservations that consume reserved slots. needs scheduler + quota tagging. ~3 sprints.
Priya (Finance): pricing thought: sell blocks (e.g., 10h, 50h) at fixed list price and also offer pre-paid credits that convert to discounted blocks. need ARR modeling and refund rules for unused hours.
Derek (Legal): contract ask: must define failure modes and credits for SLA breach. also define what happens if customer uses more than purchased blocks (auto-bill at overage rate vs deny).
billing-bot: created draft pricing doc /billing/drafts/usage-lanes-2026-03-23.json
Nia (PM): two packaging options: A) Block SKUs (fixed hours per month) + no auto-upgrade (simple) B) Credit pool (prepaid credits convertible to hours) + auto-topup optional. pros/cons?
Omar (Sales): A is easiest to sell. B useful for larger customers who want flexibility. B complicates quoting though.
Jules (Eng): A simpler on enforcement. B requires credit accounting + conversion logic. A estimate: 3 sprints to support; B: 5 sprints.
Priya (Finance): risk: with A we might underprice true infra cost during heavy months. propose a surcharge floor for peak usage or shape the block sizes to reflect cost. will run sims.
Derek (Legal): require explicit overage rule in subscription addendum. Recommend default behavior = bill at published overage rate and cap at customer's contract ceiling unless they opt-in to auto-upgrade.
Nia (PM): GA gating checklist:
- billing product definitions + pricebook entries
- sales quote templates + sample PO lines
- billing + scheduler integration tested in sandbox
- legal addendum with SLA/overage rules
- telemetry: per-org lane usage and invoice mapping
Jules (Eng): proto config for lane SKU:
```
lane_sku_priority_block:
  hours: 10
  reserved_slots: 2
  billing_code: LANE-10H
  overage_behavior: bill_at_rate
```
Priya (Finance): I'll post ARR scenarios for block sizes and a policy for credit refunds by EOD.
Omar (Sales): lining up pilot customers: StreamApp (high burst) + EduPlatform (predictable windows). will confirm next week.
Derek (Legal): will draft subscription addendum language and share in #legal-drafts tomorrow.
billing-bot: sandbox billing tests queued for PRO-4607
Nia (PM): decision: proceed with Block SKU pilot (option A) for Q3. revisit Credit Pool after pilots prove demand. action items assigned. Thanks!
